d: Deep purple hair with a soft gradient fading into pale pink at the ends, styled in long loose locks with blunt-cut bangs and a small white X-shaped clip on the left side. Golden-yellow eyes with a gentle, wide-eyed expression on a youthful, child-like face. A petite, slender build wearing a white short-sleeved sailor blouse with a light blue neckerchief, a pleated dark blue mini-skirt with white trim, and white gloves with dark blue cuffs. Accessories include a white sailor cap with a blue ribbon, brown leather belts strapped around the waist and thighs, and mechanical grey ship-rigging attached to the back.
